column1: #   GPS values interpolated to sensor timestamps (NaN = outside GPS coverage)
#   timestamp: Time since data start (sensor clock)
#   gps_time: Absolute UTC time (ISO 8601) — from $TIME sync; empty outside GPS coverage
#            To rotate vector v from body to earth: v_earth = R * v_body
#   accel_earth_*: Raw accelerometer rotated to earth frame
#   earth_accel_*: Acceleration in earth frame with gravity removed
#   gravity_body_*: Estimated gravity vector in body frame
#   linear_accel_*: Linear acceleration in body frame (gravity removed)
